description: SIDE EFFECT: for the author only. `publish` shows a hidden or held comment to every reader of the chapter; `hide` takes a comment down (it stays visible to the author). Comment ids come from get_author_inbox or get_chapter_discussion. Needs the author signed in with INITE ID and the mikefluff:author scope.
